label: THE PICK
caption: Discover. Decide. Prepare.
narration: Meet The Pick, your personal Bay Area sports concierge. It helps you choose an experience, understand the tradeoffs, and prepare for the whole outing.

label: FAMILY ON A BUDGET
caption: Two adults, two children, $120 total.
narration: First, a family day on a budget. We are starting in San Jose with two children, a hundred and twenty dollars total, and a preference for vegetarian food.

label: MAKE IT YOUR DAY
caption: Adjust location, budget, distance and personal needs.
narration: The preferences panel lets you adjust your starting point, budget, travel radius, and party size. More options cover dates, sports, dietary needs, and accessibility.

label: THE LOCAL AGENT
caption: Investigating real sources · waiting time shortened.
narration: The local AI investigates qualifying events and supporting evidence. You can follow its progress. The waiting time in this recording has been shortened.

label: YOUR FAMILY PICK
caption: One prominent winner, with clear reasons.
narration: The family recommendation is the San Jose Giants at Excite Ballpark. The winning card explains why this smaller local experience fits the request.

label: THE EVENT, AT A GLANCE
caption: Venue, date, distance, ticket price and outing estimate.
narration: Scroll through the event details: the venue, date, distance, ticket price, and total outing estimate. The card keeps evidence confidence and practical tradeoffs visible.

label: SHOW YOUR WORK
caption: Inspect the score, factors and weights.
narration: The Opportunity Score is transparent. Open the breakdown to see the factors and their weights. Evidence confidence is shown separately from how well an outing fits.

label: ALSO WORTH SHOWING UP FOR
caption: Two smaller alternatives to compare.
narration: The two smaller alternatives give you other ways to spend the day. Each has its own score, price, venue, and explanation.

label: KNOW BEFORE YOU GO
caption: Practical guidance directly beneath the winner.
narration: Preparation starts right beneath the pick, with a quick preview of bags, food, arrival, parking, seating convenience, and what to wear.

label: THE FULL VENUE GUIDE
caption: Bag policy, outside food and source conflicts.
narration: Open the full venue guide for the details. Bag and outside-food policies include official links. Conflicting clutch-size guidance is flagged rather than silently resolved.

label: PACK WITH CONFIDENCE
caption: Water, children’s needs, prohibited items and re-entry.
narration: The essentials also cover water bottles, children's and medical needs, prohibited items, and re-entry. Missing information is clearly marked for you to confirm.

label: FOOD & ARRIVAL
caption: Dietary preferences, concessions and information gaps.
narration: Food guidance lists the available concessions evidence. A vegetarian preference is not treated as a guarantee: when ingredients are unverified, the guide says so.

label: GETTING THERE
caption: Arrival guidance and honest distance estimates.
narration: Arrival advice helps you plan the visit. Distances are straight-line estimates, with driving times and event-day arrangements left for you to verify.

label: PARKING & COMFORT
caption: Parking locations, booking guidance and older sources.
narration: Parking guidance identifies the official options and where to check them. Here, the source still describes an older season, so current arrangements need confirmation.

label: FIND A COMFORTABLE SEAT
caption: Accessible seating, nearby amenities and practical tips.
narration: Seating guidance highlights accessible seating and nearby restrooms where verified. Practical tips help you compare aisle access, seat backs, steps, and proximity to amenities.

label: WEATHER FOR YOUR OUTING
caption: Real forecast near the event’s start time.
narration: The weather card shows a real forecast for this venue and the illustrative event date: temperature, feels-like conditions, rain chance, wind, and the retrieval time.

label: WHAT TO WEAR
caption: Weather-informed suggestions plus official venue rules.
narration: Clothing suggestions respond to the forecast, with layers for cooler conditions and rain protection when needed. Official umbrella and clothing restrictions appear alongside the advice.

label: CHECK THE SOURCES
caption: Official links, review dates and evidence provenance.
narration: The Sources tab lets you inspect the evidence behind the outing, including official links and review dates. Illustrative scenario assumptions are labeled separately.

label: HELP IMPROVE THE NEXT PICK
caption: Rate the outing and report corrections.
narration: You can rate the suggestion, say whether you would attend, or report a correction. This prototype saves that feedback locally.

label: THE ICONIC EXPERIENCE
caption: A different goal, with no budget or distance limit.
narration: Now let's switch to the iconic Bay Area experience. This search removes the budget and distance limits and asks for a memorable sports occasion.

label: A DIFFERENT INVESTIGATION
caption: History, rivalry and significance · waiting time shortened.
narration: The agent investigates again for this new goal, bringing sports history, rivalry, and significance into the comparison. We shorten the wait here too.

label: YOUR ICONIC PICK
caption: Cal versus Stanford: The Big Game.
narration: The recommendation changes to Cal versus Stanford, the Big Game. The app explains the rivalry's significance and why it fits an iconic experience.

label: UNDERSTAND THE TRADEOFFS
caption: Inspect this event’s venue, cost and supporting reasons.
narration: Scroll through this pick's details and tradeoffs. You can inspect its score and estimated cost before deciding whether the bigger occasion is right for you.

label: A GUIDE FOR THIS VENUE
caption: Memorial Stadium’s policies and food information.
narration: The full guide now belongs to California Memorial Stadium. Bag, food, water, and entry guidance stays tied to this venue, with any gaps clearly visible.

label: PLAN THE BIG DAY
caption: Venue-specific parking and accessible routes.
narration: Parking and seating guidance changes with the venue too. Check official parking options, accessible routes, and the seating details before buying tickets.

label: HONEST ABOUT WHAT’S UNKNOWN
caption: No forecast invented for a distant event.
narration: This November event is outside the forecast window. The app does not substitute today's weather. It shows general clothing tips until a useful forecast becomes available.

label: COMPARE YOUR OPTIONS
caption: Two alternatives for the iconic search.
narration: The iconic search also provides two alternatives, so you can compare other experiences against the top recommendation.

label: THE PICK
caption: We do the homework. You make the memories.
narration: From a family afternoon to a landmark rivalry, The Pick connects discovery, decision, and preparation. We do the homework. You make the memories.

label: ABOUT THIS DEMO
caption: Real app and AI · illustrative event listings.
narration: This recording uses the real local app and AI agent. Event dates, matchups, and prices are illustrative. Check official listings before planning a real visit.
